entities.summary: Frédéric Bernard Jean Étienne Arnault is a French businessman who has been the CEO of LVMH Watches since 2024, and the CEO of Loro Piana since 2025. He is the second son of billionaire Bernard Arnault and his second wife, Hélène Mercier-Arnault.
